gold.user: As a user, I want to retrieve a list of all mobile incoming phone numbers associated with my Twilio account so that I can manage them effectively.
gold.ideal: The response should include a JSON array of mobile phone numbers, each with details such as SID, friendly name, and status.

gold.user: As a user, I want to create a new mobile incoming phone number for my Twilio account so that I can use it for my business communications.
gold.ideal: The response should confirm the creation of the mobile number and return its SID, friendly name, and other relevant details.
